question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I will not be able to ________ my assignment in time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**complete**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**complete**" is the correct choice because it matches the infinitive structure "to ________" in the sentence.
 
• Other options do not fit the grammatical context of the sentence:
 
 
• **Completes**: Incorrect, as it is the third person singular form, which doesn't align with the sentence structure.
 
• **Completed**: Incorrect, as it represents past tense, while the sentence needs future or present infinitive form.
 
• **Completing**: Incorrect, as it represents a continuous action, which does not fit here.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I will not be able to complete__ my assignment in time.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Complete (पूर्ण करना)**: To finish or bring to an end.
 
• **Completes (पूरा करता है)**: Third person singular form of "complete."
 
• **Completed (पूरा किया)**: Past tense of "complete."
 
• **Completing (पूरा कर रहा है)**: Present participle form of "complete."
